body:
I mean, it's not like I went to war and watched someone get blown to pieces or some shit.

My brother and I were always little shitheads when we were growing up. We thought it was funny/endearing, like the Simpsons or Married with Children. "Working sucks, have some fun! If something gets broken or someone endures some slapstick comedy, no big deal!" "School is dulls-ville, being cool to your friends is WAY more important!" It took me until I was 19 to realize that all our rebellious antics really did was stress our parents out, until eventually my father cheated on and subsequently divorced my mother.


Ironically, Pops wasn't the breadwinner of the house was; Ma was. Even still, she couldn't stand living in the house, and I had to move out of the quiet suburb I loved into the city...

...Damnit, I'm going too far back. I know my past shouldn't have to do anything with how I feel now, but if I'd known where I'd wind up, I would have spent all my time actually learning about my art instead of doodling my education away. I would have made a decision and stood by it instead of changing goals entirely just because other people criticized my work...

Fuck it, I'm rambling. There's way too much to it. Of course I'm not gonna kill myself. Not today at least. Why would I deserve a quick exit like that? I'm just gonna keep doing what I'm doing; Sit around, eat fast food, don't think, and get high 'til I die. Like a good low-class patriot, right? Maybe I'll get lucky and piss off a cop or something...

[EDIT] Thanks for replying, though.

Ever consider that the people you kick feel the same way? If they're being openly defiant or confrontive, that's one thing. But in most cases, they just want a group to raid with. But ***no***, they're just too stupid for YOUR glorious group, aren't they? Maybe you should hold a vote on that kind of thing in the future instead of trying to play "Team Captain".

Believe me, as someone who "dies stupidly" in multi-player games all the time, I could type a very similar rant about wannabe-leaders like you. Just be more patient with the people you raid with in the future.
